full_prompt_en: A square urban photograph looks from a high vantage across a crowded intersection at twilight, with illuminated streets and buildings extending into the distance. A tall warm-brown masonry building rises on the left, its many windows catching scattered gold light. Another broad building occupies the right foreground, its rows of windows and roofline enclosing the main avenue between the two blocks. From the lower center, several streets converge in a busy knot of tiny pedestrians, vehicles, storefront lights, and crosswalk-like pale markings. The main street recedes toward the upper center, its bright pinpoints forming a dense ribbon of traffic and activity. Distant towers overlap in a slightly blurred skyline, while a low bank of purple-gray cloud stretches above them. The sky darkens to blue-black near the upper left, creating a dramatic tonal ceiling over the amber street grid. The image has a layered, almost time-compressed quality: some bright areas have soft ghostlike transitions, and many moving details overlap rather than appearing frozen with perfect sharpness. Warm yellow and orange lamps illuminate the façades from below, while cooler blue twilight remains in the upper stories and sky. The high viewpoint makes the city feel broad and patterned, but the nearest people and objects are very small, so the streets read as streams of light and movement. Fine photographic grain and haze keep the far background atmospheric, and reflections on the street add fragmented glints to the dark ground. The overall composition is busy and luminous, balancing a dark unsettled sky with the warm, intricate rhythm of a city in motion.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形城市摄影从高处越过暮色中的拥挤路口，望向向远方延伸的灯火街道与建筑。左侧升起一栋暖棕色高大砖石楼，许多窗格零星映出金色光。另一栋宽阔建筑占据右前景，成排窗户和屋顶线围住两楼之间的主街。数条街道从下方中央汇成繁忙节点，微小行人、车辆、店铺灯光和类似人行横道的浅色标记挤在一起。主街退向上方中央，明亮光点形成密集的交通与活动长带。远处高楼在略有模糊的天际线上重叠，一层低矮紫灰云横贯其上。天空在左上角暗成蓝黑色，像戏剧性的影调顶棚压在琥珀色街网之上。图像带着层叠、近乎时间压缩的质感：有些亮处发生幽影般的柔软过渡，许多移动细节彼此重叠，而不是完全锐利地凝固。暖黄与橙色灯从下方照亮建筑立面，较冷的蓝色暮光留在高层与天空。高视点让城市显得宽广且有纹样，最近的人和物也很小，因此街道被读成光与运动的流。细微摄影颗粒和薄雾使远景有空气感，街面反射又给暗地面添上破碎亮点。整体构图繁忙而发亮，在不安的深色天空与运动城市温暖繁复的节奏之间平衡。
style_prompt_en: The image has a layered panoramic photographic finish in which cool dusk and warm artificial light coexist within one dense field. Dark blue-gray masses settle above a web of amber, gold, and white points, creating a strong top-to-bottom tonal transition. Repeated windows and tiny bright marks make the structure intricate without requiring crisp detail in every region. Haze and slight overlap soften distant edges, while nearer masonry remains textured enough to anchor the view. An elevated viewpoint compresses depth into converging ribbons of activity, and scattered reflections break up the darker lower plane. The overall effect is bustling, atmospheric, and time-rich.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有层叠的全景摄影完成面，冷暮色和暖人工光在同一密集画域中共存。深蓝灰色块压在琥珀、金色与白色光点织成的网之上，形成强烈的上下影调过渡。重复窗格与微小亮点让结构繁复，却不要求每处都同样锐利。薄雾和轻微叠影柔化远处边缘，近处粗砺表面仍足以稳住视野。高视点把纵深压成汇聚的活动光带，零星反光打散下方暗面。整体效果繁忙、有空气感，也含有时间积累的质地。
theme_en: A crowded city intersection glowing beneath a stormy twilight sky
theme_zh: 暴风雨般暮色天空下发亮的拥挤城市路口
name: Stephen Wilkes
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
